angle: Marathon-pace running is not free. Every kilometre run at goal pace is a kilometre not run easy, and it costs more to recover from than the easy kilometre it replaced - so a week that quietly fills up with marathon-pace work ends up harder than the plan on paper, with less easy volume underneath it. The deck carries no percentage and no cap: it is about the trade, not about a number.
why: fallback for the blocked figure: the displacement argument stands on its own without a sourceable cap, and a deck with no figures needs no source rows
